tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// lam 'bras kyi gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du bkri ba'i khrid yig tshigs bcad ma bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal te// rdo rje 'chang la gnyis pa'i tshig gis 'dud// mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun gyi snying po'i don// nyung ngu'i tshig gis brjod par bya yis nyon// sdug bsngal sdug bsngal ngan song gsum gyi gnas// mdze nad shu ba'i steng na rma 'bras bzhin// legs par bsams na bsran par ga la nus// de bsams mi dge'i las las ldog par bya// mtho ris gsum na'ang 'gyur dang 'du byed de// dang po mtho dman 'gyur ba bsam par bya// gnyis pa bya bas zin pa ga la 'gyur// des na dang por 'khor ba'i nyes pa bsam// dben par gnas nas bsam gtan bsgom pa la// byis dang 'grogs na dben pa mi thob pas// skye bo dag la skyo ba bsgom bya ste// 'di yis dben pa thob cing log 'tsho spang*// de ltar 'jig rten rnam rtog btang nas ni// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*// bdag gzhan mnyam dang brje ba'i byang chub sems// don dam byang chub sems kyang bsgom par bya// de ltar bsams kyang tshe 'dir sred pa na// mi rtag pa ni thun mtshams thams cad du// yang yang dran par bya yi mi rtag pa// rtag tu mi bsam dus 'das dgos med phyir// byang chub sems gnyis bsgom pa'i thun mtshams su// mdo bklag dkon mchog mchod la brtson par bya// pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs mdor bsdus nas// snying po don gyi man ngag 'di dag yin// de tsam gyis ni blo gros ma gang ba'i// blo chen sbyangs pa zab mo dag la mos// rdo rje 'chang chen myur du thob 'dod pa// de la rdo rje theg pa sbyin par bya// bla ma brgyud pa dang ldan rgyud don rig /dam tshig mchog srung man ngag du mas brgyan// snying rjes rgyud brlan bstan bcos du ma shes// de yi zhabs bsten gsol ba lan mang btab// de yi nang nas dkyil 'khor chen po ru// zhugs la dbang bzhi po rnams rdzogs par blang*// byin rlabs phra mo tsam gyis ma yin te// sngags kyi rtsa ba dbang bskur yin pas so// de nas rtsa ba yan lag bcas pa yi// dam tshig la ni byang bas nan tan bya// de tsam gyis kyang skye ba bcu drug nas// 'grub la lam rnams kun gyi gzhi yin no// de ltar snod dang ldan pa'i gang zag la// bskyed rim lam gyi yan lag bcas bstan nas// bzlas brjod sbyin sreg dag gis rgyud sbyangs la// de nas lta ba dag la blo sbyang ngo*// dang po dngos kun sems su bsgrub bya ste// sems las ma gtogs 'di na gzhan 'ga' med// rang sems 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyis bslad de// rmi lam rta glang mig gi rab rib bzhin// sems de ngo bo nyid min sgyu ma ste// smig rgyu chu zla gtsubs pa'i me bzhin du// sna tshogs rkyen rnams tshogs nas snang ba tsam// 'di yi sems kyi rang bzhin gang yin smros// sgyu ma zhes bya ngo bo nyid kyang ni// 'di na med cing rten cing 'brel 'byung nyid// skye dang 'gag dang gnas pa yod min na// brjod bral 'di la ci zhig bsam par bya// brjod med brjod pa 'di la don med cing*// bsam min bsam par bya ba'i gnas min la// bsgom du med pa 'di la ci zhig bsgom// de ltar shes na 'dzin pa med par 'gyur// lta ba yang dag bsam pas blo sbyangs nas// de nas rim gnyis bsam gtan bsgom par bya// bskyed pa'i rim nas rim gyis blo sbyangs sam// de nyid rten du 'dzin tam blo rigs gnyis// dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid la ni// blo yi snang ba thob kyi bar du ste// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'am lhan cig skyes// gang rung sngon du song nas rdzogs rim bsgom// rdzogs rim zab mo kun gyi sngon 'gro ni// sbyang ba rnam gsum de nas rlung la bslab// sbyor ba rnam bdun gtso bo bum pa can// sangs rgyas lam ni kha sbyor dag la gnas// 'di ni 'chi ba med pa'i bcud len te// 'di ni rgas pa med pa'i sman gyi mchog

/mthu stobs du ma sgrub par byed pa'ang 'di// rim gnyis rten 'brel brtan par byed pa'ang 'di// rang byin brlab pa gtum mo phra thig gsum// las kyi phyag rgya dngos dang ye shes gnyis// de ltar rdzogs rim rnam pa gnyis kyi yang*// sngon 'gro sbyangs pa sbyang ba bstan pa yin// kha sbyor dang bral zab mo'i man ngag kun// rim gyis 'phul bar byed pa'i lam yin gyi// myur du 'grub par byed pa ma yin pas// de phyir kha sbyor lam la gus par bya// sangs rgyas yon tan kha sbyar dag na gnas// kha sbyar bsgom pa'i sgrub pa po dag la// sngon du lus sbyangs yun ring gces pa ste// nyams myong skyes nas lta ba dag dang bsre// rang sems gdod nas spros bral rgyu rgyud dang*// dbang gi ye shes lam gyi lta ba dang*// nyams myong sangs rgyas sa la ngo bo gcig /rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas zla ba'i dpe yis bstan// 'ga' zhig phyag rgya chen po thog bab ces// thog mar ston byed rmongs pa 'ga' smra mod// de ni de min lta ba'i bsam gtan te// bsgoms pa'i shugs 'byung phyag rgya chen po yin// de ltar rim gnyis lam la sbyor ba yis// drod thob nas ni spyod pas brtan byas la// sa rnams bsgrubs nas nye rgyus mtshams sbyar bas// rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon du thob par 'gyur// dge bsnyen rnal 'byor grags pa rgyal mtshan la// rgyas min snying po'i don la mos pa yi// dad gus dang bcas bra ston blo gros kyis// gsol ba btab nas sa skyar sbyar ba yin// snying po'i snying po blangs nas bstan pa 'di// tshigs bcad nyi shu rtsa bdun 'di dang brgyad/ legs par sbyar ba las byung dge ba yis// 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar bgrod shog /nyes pa'i tshogs rnams bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar bshags shing*/ dge ba sems can thams cad la bsngo ba dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig/
// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
